Subject: POC readiness & accountability for Redwood trial — next steps

Hi Lina / Samir — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed approach so we can lock owners and timelines for the POC.

Recap (high level)
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference on Avery’s real-world endpoints for the two primary flows: customer-facing chat (low latency) and nightly batch embeddings (throughput/cost).
- Success metrics we agreed on:
  - Latency: 95th percentile < 250ms for chat at target concurrency (15 qps)
  - Cost: <= $X / 1k tokens for batch embedding baseline (we'll quantify once we see sampling)
  - Quality: Acceptance tests (5 canonical prompts + 50-sample set) meet your product team baseline on relevance and hallucination tolerance

Proposed POC plan (2-week baseline + optional week for scale)
- Week 0 (prep): network checks, sample corpus delivery, access & keys, create monitoring hooks
- Week 1 (functional): run feature tests, latency microbenchmarks, embed batch run on a small shard
- Week 2 (scale/optimization): increase concurrency, test cache/batching, apply suggested quantization/profile and measure cost impact

What we need from Avery to start (please confirm owners)
- Infra/network owner: responsible for firewall rules, egress, VPC peering or allowed IPs, and perf testing VM(s).
- App/product owner: provide sample prompts, baseline acceptance criteria, and shadow traffic route for chat tests.
- Security/compliance contact: confirm data handling constraints and any additional logging/audit requirements.
- Procurement/sales ops contact: PO or procurement path and timeline for any Reserved/Dedicated discussions.

Attached: POC_scope_v1.docx (detailed plan), network_requirements_checklist.pdf, redwood_poc_template.xlsx (success criteria & eval matrix).

Next steps / asks
1) Please confirm the owners for infra, app, security, procurement by Wed (Apr 14).
2) If the above looks good, Marissa will schedule kickoff (proposed Apr 20) and we’ll hand off the POC template.
3) Karthik and I will prepare a short runbook for the infra checklist and a test deck for your product team.

Thanks — Ben

--

Ben / team — I’ll take infra as Responsible. Short checklist I’ll run through with Samir: 
- Confirm IP allowlist and egress rules for redwood inferencing endpoints (list of IPs in attached network_requirements_checklist.pdf)
- Provide sample payloads and tokenization expectations (we need a small sample corpus)
- Set up perf harness: we’ll run a 15 qps baseline with 95th pct latency measurements and share the traces
- KV/cache behavior: if Avery wants persistent cache across requests, we’ll need a small Redis instance or allow our managed cache endpoint

I’ll draft the infra runbook and aim to have it to Lina & Samir by EOD Apr 13 so they can validate by Apr 16. If the customer needs Private/VPC deployment, we should flag the potential lead time (2–3 weeks) and surface that early.
